verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management platform whose AI Teammates handle tasks and workflows. It does not author or push code commits. Signing AI-authored commits with SSH/GPG keys is a source-control axis outside its product category. Its GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket integrations only sync PR status and issues, which does not make it a commit-authoring tool.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
